nodes.label: laptop memory - reusable tools, not custom scripts

Frozen copy taken 2026-08-03 of the laptop's live memory file - evidence of what this machine believed at that date, listed unreviewed in REVIEW_REGISTER.md section 7. 2026-07-17: 'stop making fully fucking custom scripts i cant reuse for other things all the time.' The v3 harness already defines both the tooling shapes (run.py, truncate_k.py, offline_eval.py, compare_arms.py, with general arguments for run folders and globs, ids files and models) and the report shape (mean-per-metric table, target metrics faithfulness / answer_correctness / context_recall_llm first); one-off scripts and hand-rolled session tables fragment that, and he wants every capability to be a reusable harness citizen. New functionality is a general tool with folder, ids and model arguments that works on any run dir, printed through the standard table printer - never welded to one experiment's files. Surface recorded-but-unreported data such as tokens in and out and wall-times via the harness reporters, not ad-hoc prose. CANON_AUDIT.md 4.15 verdict: GROUNDED, verbatim
